name: Settlement Transaction Condition 15 Code
definition: Specifies the conditions under which the order/trade is to be settled.

ADEA.name: Accept After Regular Settlement Deadline
ADEA.definition: Settlement is on a bilaterally accepted transaction that is to be accepted beyond the regular settlement deadline.

ASGN.name: Assignement
ASGN.definition: Transfer of ownership of the asset to another party during the closing of an option.

BUTC.name: Buyto Cover
BUTC.definition: Transaction is a buy to cover.

CLEN.name: Clean
CLEN.definition: Tax-exempt financial instruments are to be settled.

DLWM.name: Delivery Without Matching
DLWM.definition: Matching receipt instruction not required (only for concerned international or national central securities depositories).

DIRT.name: Dirty
DIRT.definition: Taxable financial instruments are to be settled.

DRAW.name: Drawn
DRAW.definition: Settlement transactions relates to drawn securities.

EXER.name: Exercised
EXER.definition: Settlement transaction relates to options, futures or derivatives that are exercised.

EXPI.name: Expired
EXPI.definition: Settlement transaction relates to options, futures or derivatives that have expired.

FRCL.name: Free Clean Settlement
FRCL.definition: Delivery will be made free of payment but a clean payment order will be sent.

GATE.name: Gating Event Participation
GATE.definition: Gating event participation. Hold until event start time.

KNOC.name: Knocked Out
KNOC.definition: Settlement transaction relates to options, futures or derivatives that are expired worthless.

NOMC.name: No Automatic Market Claim
NOMC.definition: No market claim should be automatically generated.

NACT.name: Not Accounting Related
NACT.definition: Security transaction is not for accounting.

BPSS.name: Partial Successful Buy In
BPSS.definition: Identification of settlement instructions created as a result of a partial successful buy-in.

PENS.name: Pending Sale
PENS.definition: Position to cover the pending sale will be available by contractual settlement date (accounting information).

PHYS.name: Physical
PHYS.definition: Securities are to be physically settled.

RHYP.name: Rehypothecation
RHYP.definition: Collateral position is available for other purposes (for example, onwards delivery).

RPTO.name: Reporting
RPTO.definition: Relates to a transaction that is for reporting purposes only.

RESI.name: Residual
RESI.definition: Relates to transaction on a security that is not eligible at the Central Security Depository (CSD) but for which the payment will be enacted by the central securities depository.

SHOR.name: Short Sell
SHOR.definition: Account is used for short sale orders.

SPDL.name: Special Delivery
SPDL.definition: Settlement transactions to be settled with special delivery.

SPST.name: Split Settlement
SPST.definition: Money and financial instruments settle in different locations.

TRIP.name: Triparty Segregation
TRIP.definition: Securities are not be delivered but segregated following triparty collateral transaction.

UNEX.name: Unexposed
UNEX.definition: Delivery cannot be performed until money is received.
